notes: v434 — 💧 Tradeability is now a control inside every report card. Pick Any / $50k / $250k / $1m / $5k+ of daily turnover right on the card and it re-runs, filtering both the signals AND the market they're measured against — so thinly-traded shares whose moves are mostly spread noise stop distorting either side. Applies to all four cards (📋 Signal, 🏆 Top 20, 🕵️ Smart Money, 🧪 All scans), and your choice is remembered. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
